review_state.title: Why Founders Should Let AI Handle Follow-Ups But Keep the Final Say
review_state.description: Founders are losing deals in their inbox. Learn why AI follow-ups work, where humans must stay in control, and how to build a system that does both.
review_state.preview_text: Most deals don't die because of a bad pitch. They die in the silence after it. The follow-up that never went out, the check-in that was three days too late, the proposal that sat in drafts while you handled everything else that felt more urgent.
